module: Old HTML instruments controller (type "auxiliary"), deprecated: init logs an error asking to switch to genericGauges. It creates an HTML texture (htmlTexture.create) and sends 30 times per second: engaged gear, average consumption, consumption display, outside temperature, time (HH:MM), wheel speed. Not to be used for new vehicles.
notes: jbeam keys: materialName (required), htmlPath (required), unitType ("metric" by default), textureWidth (512), textureHeight (256). Without materialName or htmlPath, updateGFX is replaced by nop.
The HTML page must define setUnits and updateData; data is only sent after uiReady is called and only if a player is seated and the UI needs updating.

Consumption in l/100 km inferred from the variation of electrics.values.fuelVolume; averageFuelConsumption is bounded to 30, fuelDisplay to -1..3. Temperature in °C (obj:getEnvTemperature() - 273.15), speed in m/s.

init.desc: Logs the deprecation warning, resets the smoothers and creates the HTML texture.

updateGFX.desc: Periodically sends the data to the HTML dashboard via htmlTexture.call("updateData").

uiReady.desc: To be called when the HTML page is loaded: sends setUnits with unitType and allows updates.
